The '''Si'Klaata Cluster''' was an area in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], near the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] and the [[Sisar Run/Legends|Sisar Run]]. It contained the [[Kintan system/Legends|Kintan system]], as well as the worlds of [[Tas-La]], [[Vodran/Legends|Vodran]] and [[Vontor]], with [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]] being the most significant.<ref name="TEA" />

The Si'Klaata Cluster was the "finish line" for the [[Kessel Run/Legends|Kessel Run]], which ran from [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]].
==History==
Before the foundation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Si'Klaata Cluster was the site of a [[Xim Wars|war]] between the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]], which ended in Xim's defeat.<ref name="TEA" />

[[Outlander]] access to the Cluster was heavily restricted, and Hutt authorities of [[Ques/Legends|Ques]] interrogated thoroughly the travelers who attempted to enter.<ref name="TEA" /> This included [[Archaeologist/Legends|xenoarchaeologists]] who wished to study the [[First Battle of Vontor|First]], [[Second Battle of Vontor|Second]] and [[Third Battle of Vontor|Third Battles of Vontor]]; their attempts to gain access to those sites were stymied by the Hutts, who refused it to any researchers that did not explicitly support the Hutt version of history.
